title: Vertical slice for one domain module

name.description: Domain module name, plural kebab-case (e.g. todos, order-items).

layer.description: Emit only one core.yaml layer's files, each with the spec that layer's verify runs: "schema" the Zod schema, its spec, the table file, and the src/db/schema.ts append; "repository" the fixture, repository, and repository spec; "hook" the TanStack Query hooks and their spec; "screen" the list component, its spec, and the feature's index.ts. Omit to emit the whole slice for a new module.
